# Bloodborne PC Wiki

> Fan wiki for the bbport — the unofficial Bloodborne PC port with native Windows options, 100FPS performance, online play, mouse controls and the shadPS4 alternative.

Site: https://bbport.wiki

- Online Play — co-op and invasions: https://bbport.wiki/guide/online-play
- Controls & Settings — mouse, keyboard, controller: https://bbport.wiki/guide/controls-and-settings

## Features
